description: This PHP class provides methods for normalizing and comparing URIs, including normalizations like case-insensitive percent-encoding, decoding unreserved characters, removing default ports/hosts, and sorting query parameters.

classes.name: UriNormalizer
classes.description: A final class providing static methods to normalize and compare URIs according to RFC 3986, with configurable normalizations.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Returns a normalized URI based on specified normalization flags, including case normalization, decoding, and sorting.

methods.name: isEquivalent
methods.description: Checks if two URIs are equivalent after normalization with specified normalizations.
